text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for service `inference-api` v2.14.0 to canary (us-west-2) by jess at 23:02 UTC.

jess (infra): pushing 4 canary pods, healthchecks enabled.

shreya (prod-eng): will watch metrics and kv-cache logs.

incident-bot: ALERT: canary error-rate spike detected (>5% over 5m) for inference-api-canary. Creating PagerDuty incident PD-15823. Paging oncall rotation.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty PD-15823 triggered — notified: micah (oncall).

micah (oncall): acked PD-15823, jumping in.

micah (oncall): quick snapshot — seeing a flood of 503s from canary instances. sample log: `503 GET /v1/generate 0.34s - {'error':'cache miss'}` Looks like failure starts ~23:04.

jess (infra): can confirm spike. canary success rate down to ~30%. Rolling traffic is still 10% overall but canary-specific routing bad.

shreya (prod-eng): digging into model artifact diff — v2.14.0 includes quantized kernel pack `qk-v3` which might be incompatible with runtime kernels on canary nodes. Could explain sudden 503s during attention kv-cache ops.

micah (oncall): agree we shouldn't risk promoting. Recommend emergency rollback of the canary to v2.13.8. @deploy-bot please run: `rollback --service inference-api --to v2.13.8 --region us-west-2 --reason "canary error spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback request received from micah (oncall). Initiating rollback to v2.13.8 in us-west-2. Steps: drain canary, deploy v2.13.8, run healthchecks (readiness/liveness), reroute canary traffic.

jess (infra): tailing rollout logs now:
```
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-api -n prod
deployment "inference-api" successfully rolled out
```

incident-bot: PD-15823 update — acknowledged by micah (oncall). Assigned to SRE rotation.

luis (support): FYI we already have two customer tickets referencing 502/503 on generation endpoints in the last 8 minutes. I opened a support ticket: <https://support.internal/tickets/INC-987>. Sending a short customer note now.

micah (oncall): customer-impact assessment: limited to canary group (~10% traffic) at the moment, but automated routing could broaden exposure if autoscaler spins new canaries with the bad artifact. Rolling back stops the bleed.

shreya (prod-eng): rollback finished on canary, metrics look good — error-rate dropped to 0.3% over last 2m. KV-cache errors no longer present. Dashboard: <https://monitoring.internal/d/abc123/inference-api>

micah (oncall): marking PD-15823 as mitigated. Creating internal incident ticket with timeline and linking support ticket.

jess (infra): noted handoff — I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups in the morning. Will include model on-boarding checklist updates and a test matrix for quantized kernels.

incident-bot: Incident PD-15823 status: mitigated. Suspected root cause: quantized kernel mismatch introduced with model artifact in v2.14.0. Next actions: postmortem, model onboarding tests, pinning canary runtime-kernel matrix.

micah (oncall): handing to daytime oncall @jess (infra) for postmortem and customer comms. I'll file a concise timeline and handoff note. :white_check_mark:

jess (infra): got it. I'll draft the postmortem and set up a follow-up to ensure model + runtime compatibility gates before next rollout.

micah (oncall): final — incident resolved for now. Will update this thread in AM with full timeline and remediation items. Thanks all for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
